evidence_quotes: een watervergunning verleend voor het inrichten van een watersportgebied in de Binnenrotte
binnen de zoneringen van hierlangs gelegen boezemwaterkering
rationale: The decision of the Dutch Council of State (RvS) directly concerns a water permit (watervergunning) granted to Stichting RiF010 for developing a water sports facility in an urban waterway (Binnenrotte/Steigersgracht) and within the protection zones of an adjacent flood-defence embankment (boezemwaterkering) in Rotterdam. Under the protocol, disputes over a Dutch watervergunning and flood-defence protection zones are substantively WATER under both labels and map to regulatory_permit, with no household utility connection refusal or informal settlement involvement.
